title: Graduate civil or water engineer - expression of interest (Melbourne)
content_text: Engeny careers page invites CVs to careers@engeny.com.au when a matching role is not currently advertised. Graduate section says send CV to careers@engeny.com.au. Services include flood, stormwater, waterway management and civil; Melbourne office listed. Employee-owned environmental and water engineering consultancy.
apply_instructions: Send CV (and cover letter) to careers@engeny.com.au.
